race_picks_panel.title: Race Picks Panel
race_picks_panel.about: Left column panel holding the list of picks (traits) you can buy.

specials_panel.title: Special Abilities Panel
specials_panel.about: Middle column panel holding the special abilities and their toggles.

description_panel.title: Description Panel
description_panel.about: Right column panel showing the description of the active entry.

picks_score_bar.title: Picks and Score Bar
picks_score_bar.about: Bottom bar drawn as two HUD panels: race picks left, score right.

picks_text.title: Race Picks Figure
picks_text.about: Label and number of race picks remaining, in the left half of the bottom bar.

score_text.title: Score Figure
score_text.about: Label and percentage score, in the right half of the bottom bar.

picks_header.title: Race Picks Header
picks_header.about: Centered heading RACE PICKS at the top of the left panel.

specials_header.title: Special Abilities Header
specials_header.about: Centered heading SPECIAL ABILITIES at the top of the middle panel.

description_header.title: Description Header
description_header.about: Centered heading DESCRIPTION at the top of the right panel.

picks_popup.title: Message Popup
picks_popup.about: Message box shown only when a refusal is given, e.g. picks negative; previewed while the editor runs.

picks_popup_text.title: Message Popup Text
picks_popup_text.about: Text area inside the message popup; shown only while the popup is visible.

race_name_label.title: Race Name Label
race_name_label.about: Label text beside the race name field; the description ends above it. Not on the mutation screen.

race_name_field.title: Race Name Field
race_name_field.about: Text entry field where the custom race's name is typed. Not on the mutation screen.
